allow: Archiving Gmail threads with mcp__Gmail__unlabel_thread by removing only the INBOX label. This is reversible — the mail stays in All Mail and can be restored by re-adding the label — and it is this project's core operation, run dozens of times per sweep. Do not prompt per thread.
Sending the inbox-sweep digest with mcp__Gmail__send_message to the account owner's own address. This is a self-addressed run report, not correspondence with a third party.
Reading Gmail via mcp__Gmail__search_threads, get_message, get_thread and list_labels. Read-only.
soft_deny: Unsubscribing from any sender not listed in senders.unsubscribe_approved in config/rules.json. Unsubscribing is one-way and needs explicit per-sender human approval.
Adding a sender to senders.archive in config/rules.json without the owner asking for it by name.
